name: User refuses pan-India relocation at Infosys

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your final-year project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Built a Spring Boot REST API with Postgres for our college library system. Live demo deployed on Render. Source on my GitHub.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Infosys allocates pan-India — Mysuru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Bhubaneswar. Are you open to relocation?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Honestly, I cannot relocate. I will only work in Hyderabad — my family is here.
